description: Submit your own SaaS or AI tool. plan free_backlink is free for sites with domain rating 20+, saves the listing, and needs a visible badge link on your site (returns the badge HTML; then call verify_my_backlink). plan featured_49 ($49 Featured Launch, no backlink needed) or sponsor_149 ($149 Featured + Newsletter Sponsor) returns a price only. Nothing is saved and no email is sent until the requester approves the spend and you call again with confirmPaymentSpend true, which returns a Stripe Checkout URL. No payment happens until the requester pays on Stripe.

confirmPaymentSpend.description: Set true only after the requester approved the payment.

websiteUrl.description: Your tool's custom domain or HTTPS URL. Preview hosting domains are not accepted.

name: submit_tool
